purpose: Public landing hero (src/solares/landing/LandingGlobe.tsx). No generative image model was used for these files.

land-mask.png.method: Grey land pixels (red channel above 9 and above 0.55 x blue) scaled, Gaussian blur 2.5 px, threshold, 5 px morphological closing and 5 px median at full size; resized to 720x360 equirectangular, thresholded, 3 px closing; top 5 rows cleared. 1 bit per pixel in an 8-bit greyscale PNG.
land-mask.png.use: Sampled at runtime to decide which globe dots are land.

landing-globe-still.webp.tool: Headless Chromium (Playwright, SwiftShader WebGL) rendering LandingGlobe at 1440x900, device scale 2, reduced motion (composed frame), no layer selected
landing-globe-still.webp.method: Every element except the globe canvas hidden, transparent page background, screenshot cropped to a square 3.5 globe radii wide centred on the globe, resized to 1100x1100, WebP quality 86 with alpha.
landing-globe-still.webp.use: Static fallback when WebGL is unavailable or the context is lost, and while the 3D chunk loads. Positioned by the same --globe-* CSS variables as the live scene.

../emblem-96.webp.use: Header emblem on the landing, so the page does not load the 1.4 MB source PNG.
